description: This file contains functions and types for planning and managing the configuration of models in the OpenClaw project, including provider resolution, merging, and secret management.

methods.name: resolveProvidersForModelsJson
methods.description: Resolves providers for the models JSON configuration, combining explicit and implicit providers.

methods.name: resolveExplicitBaseUrlProviders
methods.description: Extracts providers with explicit base URLs from the configuration.

methods.name: resolveProvidersForMode
methods.description: Resolves providers based on the mode, merging with existing providers if mode is 'merge'.

methods.name: planOpenClawModelsJson
methods.description: Main function to plan the creation or update of the models JSON configuration, returning an action and contents.
